title: REQ · Shutdown unsubscribes from the store so later changes do not reach the scene
summary: After shutdown the scene's store subscription is released and store updates no longer touch the scene.
description: Context: the handler already calls this.unsubscribe, but ordering relative to the focus reset matters: the unsubscribe must run before setFocusedObject(null) so the reset does not trigger onStateChange on destroyed objects. Desired behavior: unsubscribe first, then clear focus. Expected result: onStateChange is not called after shutdown. Why: prevents calls on destroyed objects.
acceptance_criteria: Given shutdown has run, when setFocusedObject is called with an id, then no object focus or sync is invoked.
Given shutdown, when focus is cleared, then onStateChange is not called by that update.

in_scope: Ordering of unsubscribe and focus reset in the SHUTDOWN handler
preserve: unsubscribe set to null after shutdown
